songs.comment_text: This is the perfect song to dedicate to ourselves; we have struggled, we have suffered, but we always deserve a new opportunity to be happy and stop crying our hearts out.
Despite massive success, I still feel Oasis are hugely under appreciated.
I have a feeling this band singlehanded saved the local sunglasses business in the 90s.
